content: After weeks of apparent early sales leaks, The Pokémon Company just revealed its slate of products for the upcoming Flowing Fists Pokémon Trading Card Game expansion set. The fighting-themed set looks like a banger based on early card reveals, which feature fan-favorite monsters and art by popular illustrators. TCG fans shouldn't get too wrapped up in the pretty pictures or shiny wrappers, though: there's an important asterisk to the news that will impact the hobby at large.
